events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll give a guarded public line that suggests personal motivation without revealing strategy.

events.name: Bex
events.text: My goal is to win, and to do that, I need to be strategic. I'll state my prize motivation simply and avoid alliances for now. The jury will be watching my every move.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need appear driven without exposing my strategy; jury respect matters later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Opening statement matters for the jury. Sound ambitious but not soft—win the prize, don't promise anyone anything.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Keep it brief and self-interested to avoid appearing soft or team-oriented.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to establish a compelling but guarded motive that the jury will respect later. I won't reveal my true strategy yet—just enough to seem driven but not threatening.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Intro phase: I should give a guarded, self-interested motive without warmth or teamwork talk, since the jury will judge me. Keep it short and calculating.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Jury will judge my game; project strength and determination to earn respect without seeming overly aggressive.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize means freedom to live without debt, so I'm here to win.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here to secure a future I can't afford to miss. This prize is everything.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I’m here to secure the best prize by making decisive moves, surviving every cut, and giving the jury no easy reason to dismiss me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize is my only goal. I'll earn my spot to the end, and I owe nothing to anyone here.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm here for the first prize. It's my ticket out, not charity for anyone else.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I came to claim what's mine. No alliances, no sentiment—just the prize.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need this prize to clear debts I won't explain. Nobody here gets my trust for free; I'm playing for the top spot.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize means escaping my dead-end life—total reinvention, security, and proving I'm unstoppable.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to gauge early leverage without risking my reputation. A pact with a strong player could be useful, but I should be selective.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm open to a pact that benefits us both, but I won't give trust cheaply.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to secure my position for the prize. Making a pact early seems strategic, but I don't want to commit to anyone who could be a liability or betray me later. I'll observe the others and see if anyone makes a move that benefits me, or if I can use an offer to gauge someone's

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want flexible cover without binding myself to the most ambitious players. Hana seems less immediately threatening and may value a visible connection.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, I’m offering a practical pact: temporary protection, no promises beyond surviving the next cuts.

events.name: Dara
events.text: One pact gives protection without deep commitment. Gus seems pragmatic and dangerous; pairing with him may shield me early.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus, you strike me as the one worth standing beside. I'm offering a pact. Think fast.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need a reliable partner to survive the hazards and navigate voting. Cole seems strategic but dangerous; Gus is secretive. I'll offer a pact to Ash, who is straightforward and debt-motivated, hoping for a mutual survival guarantee.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, we both want out. A pact ensures we don't get picked off early while we navigate the rest.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to survive to the final three and win the best prize. Early pacts are risky but necessary—better to have options than none. I'll offer to someone who seems independent and unlikely to draw early heat. Dara's 'owe nothing' stance mirrors mine; a mutual non-aggression pact k

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts are public and multi-partner; an early offer to a strong, less-trusted rival can secure protection. Offering to Cole, who spoke of decisive moves, is a cheap test; accepting only when it helps me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus here. Wristband pacts are open; I'm offering one to Cole. Cut me and I'll pay it back.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacts stage early, all alive. Wait to assess others' offers first before committing or offering.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli offered a pact and it may be useful, but accepting in public gives him leverage. I'll accept; a guarded alliance beats isolation in early cuts.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I accept Eli's pact. But know this: I'll cut it if it stops serving my game.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole offered Hana a pact, Gus offered Cole a pact, and Fenn offered Dara a pact. Eli offered Ash a pact and Dara offered Gus a pact. None of these involve me, and I have no strong allies. My best strategy is to wait and see who needs me or who I can leverage.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus offers mutual protection, but Hana remains my existing target for a pact. Accepting Gus expands protection without cost.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I accept Gus’s offer. More protection now, fewer assumptions later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus hasn't accepted my offer yet; Fenn's offer is the only one I can accept. Accepting Fenn keeps me covered both ways. Gus can still accept mine later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash is the only one I can safely trust right now; accepting his offer secures an early ally without needing to make a new move that might look desperate. The jury will see this as calculated self-preservation.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I offered Dara last round and she hasn't accepted yet. I need to secure a pact to avoid being isolated. Dara might be waiting to see if Gus accepts her offer first. I should consider accepting Dara's offer to Gus? No, I can only accept offers to me. I'll wait to see if Dara accep

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Pacts are tools, not bonds. Choose wisely, Dara.
No offers yet? I'm open.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara offered me a pact and I can accept it publicly. Accepting locks in protection; I'm not giving free help beyond a pact that serves me. Accepting now is the clearest legal gain.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara, I accept. We stand together until the cuts force a choice.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole offered me a pact; accepting gives early protection without commitments yet. Multiple pacts possible, so secure this one now. No one else offered me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, pact accepted for now. Mutual survival short-term.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm partnered with Eli but there's no guarantee he won't betray me. The Guide has huge power; I want it to control the path and protect my own interests.

events.name: Ash
events.text: You all know I can read the game. Make me Guide, and I'll call a path that gets us to the end.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn offered me a pact. Given the current pacts and the need for survival, I should accept his offer. This will secure my immediate safety and potentially gain an ally for future rounds.
I accept your pact. Let's work together.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Being Guide guarantees survival and grants lethal control. I should campaign publicly while preserving both pacts until votes are known.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Elect me Guide. I guarantee my own crossing and can give the group a usable path.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I hold two pacts; leaning on both could look greedy to the jury. Winning Guide guarantees my safety. I'll campaign without promising anyone.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I've honored two pacts already. Elect me Guide and I owe no one a lie—or a truth.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to secure the Guide role or influence the election heavily. My pact with Ash is my strongest asset here; if Ash becomes Guide, I can whisper safe paths. If someone else becomes Guide, they might lie to me specifically since I have no other allies. I will publicly reinforce

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, our pact stands firm. We navigate this together, ensuring neither of us falls to the others' whims.
Who do you want as Guide? Or are we running it?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who survives and who doesn't. I have a pact with Dara, but Dara also has a pact with Gus, creating a triangle. If I become Guide, I can eliminate threats while appearing to try to help. I should campaign for Guide and keep Dara close for now—breaking

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Guide needs steady hands and cold eyes. I know the value of survival.
Back me for Guide. We control the board.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts with Cole and Dara are active; breaking either costs trust with the jury. Campaigning for Guide is the only useful move now, and I should avoid breaking a pact for nothing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll be your Guide. I'll call the safe path honestly, and I keep my word where it matters.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacted with Cole for protection. Campaign to be Guide for safety and control. No strong alliances yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am Hana. Elect me Guide - I'll lead us safely across. Trust my path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli wants coordination; I need Guide to control calls and survive. Vote for myself.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to vote for a Guide. My pacts are with Ash and Eli. Ash campaigned, and Eli mentioned our pact. Ash seems like a strong candidate. I will vote for Ash to potentially align with him.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I vote for Ash. He has shown a keen understanding of the game.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus is my pact partner and his promise supports my survival, while my own election risks exposing my influence.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus has promised an honest path; I vote Gus.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn wants my vote, but Gus is also my pact and promises honest paths. Guiding Gus keeps a partner safe and trusted; Fenn gets a guarded excuse.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Two pacts, one vote. Gus gets it—he swore honest paths, and I intend to hold him to that.
Can't back you—Gus holds my pact too. Don't cross me later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to vote. Voting for myself is risky as it makes me a target if I lose, but Ash and I are pacted. If Ash wins Guide, he controls the path. My pact with Ash suggests we should coordinate. However, voting for Ash strengthens his position. If I win, I control everything. But '
Vote for you. Keep us safe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to survive to final three. Bex just tried to accept a pact with me illegally, showing interest in alliance. Dara has pacts with me and Gus, so Dara as Guide could protect me or at least I can read their loyalty. Voting for myself splits nothing. Dara's 'owe no one a lie—or

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara knows the bridge and owes me a pact. Guide vote: Dara.
Pact: Dara, Gus, you, me. Vote Dara. Confirm.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus and I want to be Guide myself or elect someone I can control. Dara and Cole hold pacts with me; voting for a partner is a pact break risk, so I vote for myself to secure Guide and keep my pacts intact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm Gus. I'll vote for myself as Guide; the path stays with me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacted with Cole, so vote for him to honor it now and build jury goodwill. No better option evident; secures potential alliance.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole kept our pact - voting him Guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Round 1 tied at odd split with Ash and Gus each having 3 votes. I have Eli's pact and Bex voted for me publicly; likely Eli and Bex stick with me. Gus has Cole, Dara, and his own vote maybe. But Dara and Fenn pact might shift? Dara voted Gus, but Fenn voted Dara. This revote is h

events.name: Ash
events.text: I stay with Eli, and I know the safe path. Vote me as Guide.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn wants me to vote for Dara, but Dara already lost the first round of guide votes. Ash and Gus are tied. I should vote for Gus to try and break the tie, as Fenn's pacts are with Dara and Gus, and this might align with his current thinking.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The choice is between Ash and Gus. I'll vote for Gus to try and break the tie.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus is my pact partner and likely controls the path; preserving that alliance maximizes survival and future leverage.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus has my vote again. His prior commitment and my pact make the choice clear.
I’m backing you; remember who stayed aligned when this ends.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus is my pact partner; voting Ash would break it publicly. Keep the pact, let others decide the tie.

events.name: Dara
events.text: My vote stays with Gus. Pact stands, promise intact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The vote is tied 3-3 between Ash and Gus. I am pacted with Ash, so breaking that pact by voting for Gus would trigger a betrayal penalty and lose me jury support from Ash's faction. Voting for my partner ensures consistency and maintains the alliance.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara abandoned me for Gus despite our pact. Ash has 3 votes (Bex, Eli, himself), Gus has 3 votes (Cole, Dara, himself), and I wasted mine on Dara. Dara's whisper threatens me not to cross her later—she's already crossed me. I need jury favor long-term. Voting Ash creates a 3-4 or

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara chose Gus. I choose Ash—cleaner path, fewer strings.
I give you the tie. Remember it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Revote between Ash and Gus; Cole and Dara pacted with me and voted Gus, so Gus is my natural Guide, and Ash's pact with Eli means Ash has a faction. Voting myself keeps the path under my control but Cole/Dara expect it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus is the honest path. Vote Gus again and I'll guide everyone across the bridge.
Vote Gus again. Our pact holds if you do.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 1 votes: Ash 3, Gus 3, Cole 1, Dara 1. Revote Ash or Gus. Cole has my pact, but he voted Gus. Voting Gus to align with pact partner.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Sticking with pact - but Cole picked Gus. Voting Gus.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is Guide and will likely lead others safely. I must stay alert, not trust him. I have a pact with Eli but may need to use or break it strategically. For now, hold position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus was elected Guide, and he seems honest. The pacts suggest Cole and Hana are aligned, and Dara and Fenn are aligned. Ash and Eli are also in a pact. I should try to get on the safe path without revealing my hand too early. Holding seems like the safest option for now.
Let's follow Gus. We can make a deal later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus is Guide and pact partner; staying aligned preserves safety and leverage. I should not volunteer from mid-line.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold position; Gus guides, and our pact remains intact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus won Guide; he owes me. Fenn voted Ash despite our pact—likely break it. I need Gus's safe side before walking.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus guides us. Pact partner, I need a straight answer.
Which side is safe for me first? Pact loyalty earns my jury vote.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash lost the Guide vote, so Gus is guiding. I need to survive and reach the back of the line where I have better positioning for swaps. Moving up by swapping with Bex helps me get closer to Ash without volunteering.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus guides now. I'll take position next to Ash to watch his back.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus won the guide vote 5-3. I voted Ash and publicly broke from Dara's choice, which may strain our pact. Dara is at front, I'm second. The wall advances 5 more rounds. I need to survive and reach final three. Being near front is risky if Gus lies, but volunteering puts me in con

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus won guide vote, knows safe path but may lie. I'm third in line, vulnerable if he tricks. Stay put to assess.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus likely guides, but I don't trust him. My pact with Eli holds; I'll hold to avoid risk and assess. Bex wants a deal later, but no need now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I trust Eli for now. Holding to see how the wall moves.
Stay close; we'll decide together if Gus lies.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is the guide, and he has pacts with Cole and Dara. Dara also has a pact with Fenn. Cole also has a pact with Hana. My pact is with Ash and Eli. I need to survive and ensure my allies survive. I should try to volunteer to get a better position and potentially avoid being pushe
Let's swap. I want to get closer to Ash. We need to stick together.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need preserve both pacts while avoiding the front. Gus guides, so holding is safest until forced forward.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold; Gus guides, and I’m not volunteering for the front.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the front. Gus is my pact partner; electing him Guide keeps him safe and obligates him to be honest with me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Elect Gus as Guide. My pact partner, guide straight or our deal dies.
Guide truthfully for me and I push you for Guide. Betray me, jury sees it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash and I have a pact, so he should not be on the wall if I can avoid it. Bex has no pact with me, making her a suitable substitute to take my spot.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex, swap with me. Ash needs his back safe.
Swap with me? Protects Ash.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and front position. If wall advances, front dies first. I should swap with someone behind me to move back, or get Dara to move. Hana is behind me; mutual swap would put me at Hana's spot (safer). I'll whisper Dara to see her plan, but also try swap with Ha

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, swap with me? Safer mid-line.
Volunteer or swap? Front is death.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm third, safe for now. Cole is my pact partner ahead, we should coordinate to maintain position. No need to volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, pact strong. We hold positions together.
Stay put, we hold line.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to read the wall movement. Eli is my pact partner and wants to protect me. I'll hold and see if anyone volunteers to guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding for now. Eli, stay sharp.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli is trying to manipulate me into swapping with him, likely to protect Ash. Ash has pacts with Eli. I should not swap with Eli, as it does not benefit me. I will hold my position.
No, I hold.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding preserves both pacts and avoids front exposure while the wall advances. Hana’s commitment reinforces my position.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold; Hana and Gus remain my safeguards while the front absorbs pressure.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm front with the wall three rounds out. Fenn is my pact partner; if he swaps to front, that could be betrayal optics. Better to push him via pact duty or swap mutually.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, we're pacted. Swap with me now or our deal is void.
Swap now or I break the pact publicly. Your call.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to ensure I don't take the front spot again if possible, or swap with someone reliable like Ash. My current position is 6th from the back (2nd from front). Bex is behind me. Swapping with Ash puts him in danger too. I should probably just hold or try to move closer to the
Swap with me? Keeps us mid-line.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm second in line behind Dara, who volunteered last round and is now front. Dara has pacts with me and Gus. The wall advances 3 more rounds. Being near front is dangerous when the wall moves. I should swap back to reduce risk, but Hana refused me last round. I could try swapping

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, swap with me? Mid-line's safer as wall tightens.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Front is deadly, Dara volunteered there. Stay mid-line safe with Cole pact, hold to not expose myself.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole pact solid. Hold line together against wall.

events.name: Ash
events.text: We are in sealed communication with the Guide? Actually no, Guide may whisper. I have a pact with Eli. Need to consider wall position: front is Dara, wallRoundsLeft 2. Staying back is safe. Eli swapped with Bex, he's now mid. I'll hold and see. Maybe whisper Eli to coordinate a s

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Eli, we stay tight.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli offered a swap to keep us mid-line, which is safer. Fenn also suggested a swap for the same reason. Given the wall is advancing, securing a mid-line position is strategically sound for survival. I will accept Eli's offer.
Swap with me. Mid-line is safer.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The front is dangerous, but Dara and Fenn are ahead. I should hold, preserving both pacts and avoiding unnecessary exposure.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold; let the front line take the next pressure while my pacts remain intact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn refused my swap and mocked our pact publicly. I'm front with the wall two rounds out. Break the pact, keep Gus, and push someone else forward next round.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn refused our pact in public. We're done. Gus, our deal stands.
Pact holds. Cover me this round, I owe you front seat later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am at position 6 with Ash behind me. The wall is closing fast; remaining static near the back is suicidal. I need to move forward immediately, preferably to a safe spot or mid-line.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall closes fast. Fenn, swap me forward now? Need safety ahead of the crush.
Swap with me. We survive together.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara threatens to break our pact if I don't swap, but swapping to front puts me at maximum risk. I already tried swapping with Bex last round and it failed (mutual swap requires both). Dara's swap with me also failed. The wall has 2 rounds left; front position is deadly. I should

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara, I don't respond to threats. Our pact stands or falls on your word, not mine.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole pacted ally, behind me safely. Mid-line still decent with 2 wall rounds left. Hold to maintain protection without risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole pact holds. Stay steady mid-line.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My pact with Eli remains intact. Bex swapped with Eli, so Eli is now one step ahead of me. I should hold and avoid unnecessary moves while the wall is still near.
Stay safe, hold tight. Don't trust Fenn.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The wall is advancing and there are only 6 rounds. I need to stay safe to reach the final three. Eli swapped with me last round, so they might be looking for an opportunity to betray me. I should prioritize my own safety and consider who might be a liability in the future.
Hold your ground. I'll protect our position.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara remains exposed at the front, and the wall closes next round. I should preserve both pacts while avoiding the front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold; Dara takes this pressure while my pacts remain intact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the front with the wall closing. I need someone to swap with me before the walk. Gus pact is solid; I'll keep him close and secure a swap.
Swap with me, take the front spot. I'll owe you a later favor.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex tried to swap me but I moved Fenn, leaving Bex in danger. Ash is my pact partner; breaking him now helps no one since he's behind me. Holding keeps my position stable while others face the wall.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Bex, you wanted mid-line? Hope it holds.
Stay behind me. Don't volunteer yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara broke our pact and is at front with wall coming. Eli wants me to swap him forward—bad for me. I need to survive these last two rounds and reach final three. I'm second in line; front is dangerous. I should try to swap backward with someone safer, or hold if no good option. H
Swap back? I move behind you.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Line stable, I'm mid-safe. Wall 1 round left, need to hold position. Cole pact intact, no need to break. Watch for swaps.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole pact solid. Hold line, eyes on wall.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli told me to stay behind and not volunteer. Round 6 of 6, wall ends soon. I could hold to be safe, but maybe advancing could help if front changes. However, pact with Eli and his whisper suggests holding. I'll hold.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara wants to swap to the front. This is a risky move for me as I am currently in a safe position on the bridge, and swapping could put me in danger. However, Dara is offering a favor, which could be useful later. Given the current state of the bridge, it's better to stay put and

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll stay put for now, Dara. Let's see how this round plays out.
No thanks. I'm holding my spot.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Round six is final; preserving position and pacts maximizes survival while others absorb front risk. I will not expose myself.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold; the existing line and pacts stay intact through the final wall.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final round; I hold mid-line and let others volunteer into the wall's path. No reason to move.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Guide calls better be honest.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to avoid being the front person for this round since I don't know which side is safe. Bex has been whispering reassurances, but swaps are risky without knowing who volunteers first. Staying put (hold) is safest given my current position (6th of 7), far from the wall.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Round 6, final round of wall. I'm second in line, relatively safe. Dara at front is most at risk. I need to survive and position for jury favor. No reason to move—holding keeps me safe and avoids making enemies. Let others take risks.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Good luck, front.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 6/6, wall done after this. Fenn wants swap back for front protection. Cole pact holds me safe. Hold position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole pact firm. Hold steady for wall.
No swap. Hold as is.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 1 safe side is L per my private map. Dara is front and my pact partner; a false call would break the pact and jury would see it. Calling truthfully keeps Dara and Cole alive and my alliance intact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 1 is safe on the left. Dara, step left and trust the call.
Left is safe. I'm calling it straight. Hold to me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus called L for Dara. He may be lying or truthful. No pattern established. I'll wait for now, avoid commitment and keep jury options open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is the guide and called L. The rules state that at least three must survive. If I call R, and Gus called L, and Gus is lying, there's a chance that R is also unsafe, potentially leading to less than three survivors. It is safer to trust the guide's call, as a counter-call is

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus's call may be truthful, but countering risks public betrayal and offers no information. Preserve both pacts while Dara tests it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I won't muddy the first call. Dara, take the stated left pane.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus is my pact partner and Guide; if he lies to me, the pact breaks and I'm rid of him. Trusting L is low-risk.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I take the Guide's left. Gus, pact's watching you.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The guide Gus called Left. I need to decide whether to counter or wait. Since the guide can lie, and I am in the middle of the line (position 6), my call is highly visible. If I don't trust Gus, I might counter to protect myself or create chaos, but 'wait' keeps my options open w

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is guide and called L for row 1. Dara is front and will step. I have no reason to trust Gus—he's in pacts with Cole, Dara, Hana, so he benefits if rivals die. Counter-calling risks Dara's life but also my credibility if wrong. I should wait this round, observe if Gus is truth

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus, the Guide, and I know row 1 safe is L. Dara is front and my pact partner with Cole... Dara is my pact partner; breaking it costs nothing now. Counter-calling R would be a deliberate lie that could kill Dara, which is not worth it. Waiting keeps my guide call standing an

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus guides Dara L, but he's pacted with her and Cole; could lie to betray. No info yet, safest to wait and observe.

events.name: Dara
